title: Discovery of METTL3 inhibitor C191-0266 as a leukemia therapeutic through targeted modulation of protective autophagy.
authors: Hu, Xiaopeng; Zhu, Hua; Li, Chenyang
one_liner_zh: 该文用CNN发现METTL3抑制剂用于白血病治疗，核心是蛋白-小分子药物筛选，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: To develop novel anti-leukemia therapies, a CNN model identified C191-0266 targeting METTL3, which exhibited potent anti-leukemia activity. It inhibited the proliferation of OCI-AML3, MOLM-13, and THP-1 cell lines with IC(50) values of 16.91 muM, 19.01 muM, and 24.99 muM respectively, showed strong METTL3 binding (K(D) = 7.28 muM) and enzymatic inhibition (IC(50) = 7.639 muM), enhanced Ara-C's cytotoxicity by suppressing Ara-C-induced protective autophagy, maintained stable binding to METTL3, regulated the NF-kappaB pathway to inhibit TNF-alpha overexpression in Ara-C-resistant cell lines, and had favorable pharmacokinetics and safety profiles via ADME assessments, thus holding promise as an anti-leukemia drug candidate.
abstract_zh: 为开发新型抗白血病疗法，一个CNN模型识别出靶向METTL3的C191-0266，该化合物表现出强效的抗白血病活性。它抑制了OCI-AML3、MOLM-13和THP-1细胞系的增殖，其IC(50)值分别为16.91 μM、19.01 μM和24.99 μM，显示出与METTL3的强结合能力（K(D) = 7.28 μM）和酶抑制活性（IC(50) = 7.639 μM），通过抑制Ara-C诱导的保护性自噬增强了Ara-C的细胞毒性，与METTL3保持稳定结合，调节NF-kappaB通路以抑制Ara-C耐药细胞系中TNF-alpha的过度表达，并通过ADME评估显示出良好的药代动力学和安全性特征，因此有望成为抗白血病药物候选物。
